name: global-crash-at-phone-home
about: Global crashes with the worker's op_update{completed} read but not committed. The durable phone_home observation must still complete the deploy.

name: mac-only-phone-home-mid-install
about: A phone-home that names no operation arrives mid-install. It must be refused and change nothing.

name: slow-bmc-resets-host-that-booted-the-installer-on-its-own
about: The host is already PXE-booting when the deploy is created and installs on its own while the executor's power cycle waits on a slow BMC. The late cycle and its phase writes must not reopen the installer after deploy_complete.
